title: Power flow — distinct input and output cards

steps.path: Power → Right now; also shown on Overview
steps.headline: Give every major input and output its own card
steps.changed: Separate adapter, battery, CPU, GPU and other-hardware cards. Consistent surfaces, icon tiles, quieter borders, larger numbers and thin routed connections replace the rainbow ribbons.
steps.notice: The red battery card explains the adapter shortfall. A central Adapter + battery total connects the two sources to the separate consumers below.
steps.risk: Uses more vertical space. While charging, the battery moves to the receiving row. These are fixed example readings; approving the design does not install it.
